description: Paid: 0.003 RLUSD per call via x402 on XRPL mainnet (xrpl:0), or 0.003 USDC on Base (eip155:8453). Pay per call, solves one question: When are sunrise, solar noon and sunset at this point on this date? Sunrise, solar noon and sunset as explicit UTC instants, computed locally from the published NOAA/GML solar-calculator equations (after Meeus), with stated accuracy (about 1 minute within 72 degrees latitude, up to 10 minutes beyond). A calculation, not an observation; not NOAA data and not endorsed by NOAA. Without payment this returns isError with the x402 PaymentRequired object (fresh invoiceId); retry with the signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"] or the payment_signature argument. Unpaid calls cost nothing.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD (local mean solar date at the longitude)

payment_signature.description: Optional. Base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value (signed RLUSD or USDC PaymentPayload) for hosts that cannot set _meta["x402/payment"]. Omit on the first call to receive the payment requirements.

name: solar_times
title: Sunrise, sunset, solar noon (paid: 0.003 RLUSD / 0.003 USDC on Base / 0.003 RLUSD on Base via x402)
